source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U22: Distinguish disqualification,vacation,directorship limits and whole-time roles

payload.title: Eligibility,continuing office and employment are separate
payload.core_explanation_md:
A director must meet the relevant eligibility rules and avoid statutory disqualification. Vacation of office has specified triggers,such as the described absence from all board meetings over twelve months; a leave request does not automatically remove that trigger. Judicial orders,conviction and appeal qualifications require the exact current text rather than the textbook blanket immediate-vacation statement.

The described directorship limits are twenty overall and ten public-company positions,subject to statutory counting rules and any lower member-imposed limit. Count alternate positions and the relevant private-company group relationships correctly. A whole-time director is in whole-time employment; managerial appointment terms and reappointment timing are distinct from mere share ownership. Do not treat qualification-share wording as a universal current statutory requirement.

self_check.prompt_text: Does leave automatically erase the twelve-month all-meetings absence trigger?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The described rule includes absence with or without leave.

payload.stem_md: A director misses every board meeting for the stated twelve-month period and relies solely on leave approvals. Which issue remains?

options.text_md: Leave necessarily preserves office in every case
Only the number of emails sent
options.explanation_md: Emails do not replace the statutory test.
The source includes absence with or without leave.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source includes absence with or without leave.

payload.stem_md: A director counts only ordinary appointments and ignores alternate directorships when testing the overall limit. What must be reconciled?

options.text_md: The statutory counting rules,including the relevant alternate positions
options.explanation_md: A label does not remove a counted position.
Share count is not directorship count.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A label does not remove a counted position.
